template: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE original standalone macOS launcher app icon, matching the supplied A sculpted icon family as a STYLE REFERENCE ONLY. Precise rounded-square colored tile, softly sculpted ivory foreground object, controlled shallow satin dimensionality, top-left studio light and minimal internal contact shadows. Premium cohesive professional icon, clean readable at 28px. NO fog, smoke, grain, bloom, glass, white page background, labels, caption, extra objects, or external drop shadow. Square transparent PNG: keep the colored tile opaque; genuinely transparent area OUTSIDE its rounded contour. Center tile with 5% transparent margin on EACH side, 90% canvas width/height, consistent corner radius approximately 22% of tile edge. Bold simple optical geometry, generous internal breathing room. Color: {color}. Functional symbol: {subject}. Do not reproduce the reference sheet or its other icons; deliver only this single new icon.
